changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionQueryAttributeType') BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionQueryAttributeType_backup') BEGIN SELECT * INTO [dbo].[FusionQueryAttributeType_backup] FROM [dbo].[FusionQueryAttributeType] END
DELETE FROM [dbo].[FusionQueryAttributeType]
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionQueryAttributeType_Fusion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionQueryAttributeType] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionQueryAttributeType_Fusion] END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionQueryAttribute') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionQueryAttribute_FusionQueryAttributeType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionQueryAttribute] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionQueryAttribute_FusionQueryAttributeType] END END
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS [dbo].[FusionQueryAttributeType] END
